title: Sticker Mule: Software engineer
description_review: Remote full-stack software engineer position building customer and creator tools (Stores, AI tools, Notify, Reply) for an e-commerce platform. Stack features Go, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and GCP with aggressive AI integration. Offers $150,000–$250,000 USD annual salary with a $20,000 signing bonus.
pros: End-to-end product ownership in small autonomous teams matches senior engineering profile
Strong transparent compensation ($150k–$250k USD) and remote-first setup
TypeScript and PostgreSQL match candidate's stack capabilities
cons: Primary backend stack is Go rather than Java/Spring Boot
Frontend relies on React rather than Angular or Vue.js

title: A.Team: Senior Independent AI Engineer / Architect
description_review: High-impact independent senior AI engineer and architect network working on production AI deployments for startups and enterprises. Scope focuses on agent architectures, multi-agent orchestration, retrieval systems, and enterprise LLM infrastructure. Remote role open to the Americas, Europe, and Israel.
pros: Direct focus on agent architectures and orchestration systems matches candidate's multi-agent platform work
Enterprise AI deployments and reliability infrastructure align with candidate's enterprise modernization focus
Senior architectural scope working with founders and technical leaders on production-grade systems
cons: Invite-only contract and fractional network rather than a single full-time direct corporate role

title: A.Team: Senior Independent Software Developer ($90-$170/hr)
description_review: Senior independent software developer role in an invite-only network delivering greenfield and modernization projects for enterprise clients and top-tier startups. Engineers work in small teams of 3–4 builders with full project autonomy and client guidance. Compensation ranges from $90 to $170 USD per hour.
pros: High hourly compensation ($90–$170/hr) with full autonomy over project selection
Senior scope leading architecture, scoping, and execution for enterprise clients
Matches senior software engineering and enterprise consulting background
cons: Client-dependent project stack without guaranteed Java or Spring Boot focus
Independent contractor model rather than stable permanent employment

title: Frontend Engineer at Bjak
description_review: Web frontend engineer position building productivity application surfaces (Chat, Notes, Docs, Sheets) with native AI capabilities for ActAI. Involves real-time messaging, collaborative editing, streaming AI responses, and reusable UI components. Position located in Ireland with unstated salary.
pros: Involves streaming AI responses and model-driven UI workflows
Focuses on complex interactive UI architecture and state management
cons: Pure frontend engineering role misaligned with candidate's backend and architecture strengths
No Java, Spring Boot, microservices, or enterprise backend development

title: AI agent engineer at Sticker Mule
description_review: Remote AI agent engineer position responsible for building, operating, and managing autonomous teams of AI agents. Requires experience building independent agents using Claude, OpenAI, Grok, Go, TypeScript, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL. Compensation is $150,000–$250,000 USD per year with a $20,000 signing bonus.
pros: Direct alignment with candidate's experience building multi-agent platforms and agent harnesses
Includes TypeScript, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL from candidate's technical profile
Strong compensation package ($150k–$250k USD) and fully remote environment
cons: Backend relies primarily on Go instead of Java and Spring Boot
Domain focuses on commerce and manufacturing rather than financial services or enterprise systems
